Diamond Hill Capital Management INC Increases Stake in Discover Financial Services (DFS)
May 23, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Investors sentiment increased to 0.87 in Q4 2017. Its up 0.10, from 0.77 in 2017Q3. It improved, as 51 investors sold DFS shares while 266 reduced holdings. 99 funds opened positions while 176 raised stakes. 296.68 million shares or 1.53% less from 301.28 million shares in 2017Q3 were reported. 86,325 are owned by Hightower Limited Liability Company. Chevy Chase Trust Hldg owns 328,291 shares. Security Natl Trust Comm stated it has 0.03% of its portfolio in Discover Financial Services (NYSE:DFS). Kentucky Retirement holds 0.12% of its portfolio in Discover Financial Services (NYSE:DFS) for 22,409 shares. Lsv Asset Mgmt has invested 0.84% in Discover Financial Services (NYSE:DFS). Public Employees Retirement Of Ohio holds 154,773 shares or 0.06% of its portfolio. Massmutual Tru Fsb Adv reported 44 shares. Asset Mngmt One Limited reported 586,168 shares. Duncker Streett And holds 0.3% or 15,355 shares. Diligent Ltd owns 13,345 shares. Ubs Asset Management Americas has invested 0.08% in Discover Financial Services (NYSE:DFS). Barrow Hanley Mewhinney Strauss Limited Liability Corp accumulated 1.36 million shares. Amica Mutual accumulated 90,318 shares. Captrust Finance Advsr has invested 0% in Discover Financial Services (NYSE:DFS). Manufacturers Life Insurance The invested 0.11% of its portfolio in Discover Financial Services (NYSE:DFS).
Ric Dillon increased its stake in Discover Financial Services (DFS) by 3.17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Diamond Hill Capital Management Inc bought 222,754 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.95% with the market. The hedge fund run by Ric Dillon held 7.26M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $558.27M, up from 7.04 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Diamond Hill Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Discover Financial Services for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $26.78B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.44% or $1.12 during the last trading session, reaching $76.75. About 509,404 shares traded. Discover Financial Services (NYSE:DFS) has risen 5.15% since May 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 6.40% the S&P500.
Diamond Hill Capital Management Inc, which manages about $12.19 billion and $19.96 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Marsh & Mclennan Cos. Inc. (NYSE:MMC) by 304,474 shares to 2.28 million shares, valued at $185.60 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 30,236 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 2.32 million shares, and cut its stake in Avis Budget Group Inc. (NASDAQ:CAR).
